verdicts.reason: The quoted paginate raises ValueError when page or size is below 1 and returns items[(page-1)*size : page*size]. That gives [4,5] for page 2 of five items with size 3 and an empty list past the end, and the named tests cover each of these cases.

The full suite run with python -m pytest -q at commit 99e5a65 shows 7 passed and 0 failed. With the old paging.py, 4 of the new tests fail (4 failed, 3 passed, 7 in all), so the suite has tests that catch the old behaviour.
The quoted CHANGELOG.md has a bullet under '## Unreleased' about the fix for the dropped last item and page 0, including the new ValueError.
